title: One Lump, or Two
description: One Lump, or Two — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Head down into the Crypts R Us off of Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow and get the identity of the Smuggling Agent. Report back to TDA Agent Anise Rawgers in the Balzack's Burrow Base Camp when you are finished.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: TDA Agent Anise Rawgers

Repeatable: No

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head down into the Crypts R Us off of Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow and get the identity of the Smuggling Agent. Report back to TDA Agent Anise Rawgers in the Balzack's Burrow Base Camp when you are finished.

Offer:

It is time for some direct action here, Dungeon Runner. The TDA cannot stand idle while Abadunkadunkaddonna smuggles her Sweetener into Balzack's Burrow. Have you ever seen her dance? It's interpretive and the only interpretation I can take from it is crap. If she gets all of the monsters in Balzack's Burrow doing the same dance, well...I just don't want to consider that reality.

Normally we would try and strike directly at Abadunkadunkaddonna herself, but she is all the way up in The Embercore Path and that is just too far of a walk. Instead, how about you take out her Smuggling Agent here? I thought you would like that option.

Now we don't know who her Agent is here in Balzack's Burrow, but we think that they are down in Crypts R Us. Head down there and find out who Abadunkadunkaddonna's Smuggling Agent really is, then bring the proof back to me. Who am I? Why, I'm Anise Rawgers, TDA Agent here in Balzack's Burrow Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Oh no, it was an Abba Labba? Those things are so creepy. They're like small horrible orange children and smell like Fizz Rock.

Well thank you for you help in this sensitive matter, Dungeon Runner. The TDA appreciates your discretion, cooperation, and candy...er...candor. I meant candor.

I need some FizzStar...err...Red Karl. Here, take this and go.

Objectives:

  • Uncovered Smuggler's Identity ×1

Level range: 57–100
